acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

constructor.details: The deploying address becomes the initial owner. Transfer ownership to a      multisig or timelock before mainnet production use.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.payAmount: The USDC amount to contribute this call. Must be > 0 and <= remaining share balance.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

reclaimStuckPayout(uint256).details: Only callable when payoutClaimable > 0 (push failed, no redirect succeeded).

recoverToken(address,address).details: Only sweeps the surplus above what active bill accounting tracks.      Cannot withdraw amounts reserved for refunds or unclaimed payouts.

params.token: The ERC-20 token to recover (use address(usdc) for USDC).

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

votePayoutRedirect(uint256,address).details: This is the non-creator recovery path for an unresponsive creator.

MAX_BILL_DURATION().notice: Default deadline applied when creator passes deadline == 0. Guarantees every bill has a finite expiry so claimExpiredRefund is always reachable.

MIN_CANCEL_THRESHOLD_NUMERATOR().notice: Minimum cancel threshold as a fraction of eligible voters (numerator/denominator = 51/100 → majority). Prevents single-actor cancellation by requiring at least a majority of eligible voters.

MIN_REDIRECT_QUORUM_NUMERATOR().notice: Minimum redirect quorum: strictly more than half of contributors must agree. Prevents a single participant from redirecting the payout to themselves.

PAYOUT_RECLAIM_TIMEOUT().notice: Timeout after settlement before contributors can reclaim a proportional share of unclaimed stuck payout.

PAYOUT_REDIRECT_GRACE().notice: Grace period after settlement before participants may vote to redirect an unclaimed payout.

claimPayout(uint256).notice: Fallback payout claim: only needed when the automatic push on settlement failed.Unclaimed payout redirection is participant-governed through votePayoutRedirect().

createBill(uint256,bytes32,address,addre.notice: Creates a bill with up to MAX_PARTICIPANTS participants.

getShareProgress(uint256,address).notice: Returns how much a participant has contributed and how much remains on their share.

pay(uint256,uint256).notice: Pay any portion of your share. Can be called multiple times until share is fully covered.

protocolRiskAcknowledged().notice: Returns true always — exists to make the documented protocol risk discoverable on-chain.

reclaimStuckPayout(uint256).notice: Emergency reclaim: if a settled bill's payout remains unclaimed for 91 days,         contributors can reclaim their proportional share of the stuck payout.

recoverToken(address,address).notice: Recover tokens accidentally sent to this contract.

votePayoutRedirect(uint256,address).notice: After PAYOUT_REDIRECT_GRACE has elapsed since settlement and payout is still unclaimed, any participant who contributed to the bill may vote to redirect the payout to a candidate address. When votes reach cancelThreshold, the payee is updated to candidate and payout becomes claimable by them.
